items.title: Microsoft MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash generally available in GitHub Copilot
facts: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash are now generally available in GitHub Copilot.
MAI Code 2 is a powerful general purpose coding model ideal for deep debugging, multi-file implementation, refactoring, and repository-wide reasoning.
MAI Code 2 Flash is a lightweight cost-efficient model for code explanations, targeted edits, routine fixes, and rapid iteration.

items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol available in GitHub Copilot, Codex, and API
facts: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now generally available in GitHub Copilot.
Both models are designed for agentic coding and code review, with stronger coding judgment than earlier GPT-6 models.
GPT-6.2 Astra is OpenAI’s latest Astra model for agentic coding and terminal work; GPT-6.2 Sol is for complex agentic coding and in-depth code review.

items.title: Cursor details October security incident involving Fireworks key and malicious Claude Code extension
facts: An attacker obtained an access key Cursor had issued to Fireworks, which Fireworks exposed, and used it to copy limited coding agent traces.
The attacker placed malicious unauthorized copies of Anthropic's Claude Code extension on the Cursor VS Code extension marketplace cache on October 29.
At most 5,000 users who requested specific cached versions potentially received the malicious build; Cursor says the incident is contained.

items.title: Google Antigravity robotics plugin with Gemini 4 Hydrogen for conversational robot task training
facts: With Gemini 4 Hydrogen and the new robotics plugin for Google Antigravity, you can connect a supported arm, practice in MuJoCo simulation, and run tasks in the real world using plain conversation.

items.title: JetBrains 2026.3 IDEs ship with Air for agentic development
facts: The 2026.3 versions of JetBrains IDEs are out, with Air.
Air lets agents do more of the work while you stay in control of what ships, with one place to review every change.
Supports Claude Agent, Codex, Copilot, Junie, and more; bring your own subscriptions or use Junie Lite for free.

items.title: Developers share Claude Code skills and persistent memory workflows for agent reuse
facts: Users describe saving work procedures as SKILL.md files in Claude Code and Codex for reuse by asking the agent to turn the current procedure into a Skill.

items.title: Microsoft AI claims strong price-performance for MAI Code 2 vs GPT-6 and Claude on everyday coding benchmarks
facts: Averaged over four benchmarks (DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal Bench 2.1, SWE-Atlas and FrontierCode v1.1), MAI Code 2 gives 98% of the performance of GPT 6.1 Sol at 40% of the cost, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5’s performance at 5% of the cost.
MAI Code 2 Flash offers comparable performance to GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at 65% and 20% of the cost on day-to-day high-volume coding tasks.

items.title: Hot discussion on agentic coding evolution, review bottlenecks, and residual human role
facts: A widely engaged post outlines a timeline of AI coding developments and concludes that no-one is writing code anymore while the community figures out the implications.
